description: THE REOPEN DECISION as DATA -- the twin of should_continue, run the OTHER way. stopping_policy STOPS by SUFFICIENCY and deliberately leaves low-salience gaps UNFIXED (gap_prioritization.run_cycle's `left` set -- the DEFERRED agenda). This seed lets the jabberwock DECIDE WHEN TO REOPEN one of those deferred gaps and PASS IT THROUGH into the running session. ONE graph-resident Program, should_reopen, is the twin of should_continue: for a DEFERRED gap it REOPENS iff the gap's CURRENT (re-measured) norm_salience exceeds the ReopenPolicy threshold -- Gt(gap.norm_salience, ReopenPolicy.threshold) inside an IfThenElse, both the gap-attr read and the threshold read living in the graph (the threshold via an Argmin over ReopenPolicy by priority, exactly as should_continue reads SufficiencyPolicy). The gap node is bound as env var `g`; Python passes only the id and reads the Program's 1.0/0.0 output -- it never compares salience to a threshold in Python, never counts ticks, never flags. HYSTERESIS is a STATED POLICY, not an accident: ReopenPolicy.threshold (0.7) is DISTINCT from and >= SufficiencyPolicy.threshold (0.5), so a gap DEFERRED at salience 0.2 does NOT immediately reopen -- reopen is a strictly HIGHER bar than un-defer; the gap reopens only once re-measurement lifts its salience above the higher reopen bar. The salience RE-MEASUREMENT is the perceivers'/normaliser's boundary I/O; the reopen threshold is graph-data POLICY (tunable). PASS-THROUGH is a genuine live-graph hand-off, not a print: a reopened gap is PROMOTED to a ReopenedConcern node with active=1, edged from the agent hub (has_concern), which the LIVE loop consumes -- the seeded `reopened_concern_pursue` Reflex's stimulus (an active ReopenedConcern exists) trips in fire_reflexes, so the running session SEES and acts on the reopened issue. The reopened gap re-enters the LIVE session, not the batch queue.

microtheory.name: issue_reopen
microtheory.description: when a DEFERRED gap (left unfixed by the sufficiency stop) is REOPENED and passed back into the running session: it reopens iff its CURRENT re-measured norm_salience exceeds the ReopenPolicy threshold -- a strictly HIGHER bar than the sufficiency threshold that deferred it (hysteresis). The reopen verdict is the should_reopen Program's output (Rust); the salience is re-measured at the boundary; the reopened gap is promoted to an active ReopenedConcern the live reflex/rule loop consumes.

attrs.name: default_reopen_policy
attrs.description: the re-measured-salience bar a DEFERRED gap must clear to be REOPENED into the running session. DISTINCT from and deliberately HIGHER than the SufficiencyPolicy threshold (0.5) that deferred it: this is HYSTERESIS -- a gap deferred at 0.2 does not reopen when it drifts to 0.6; it reopens only once re-measurement lifts its salience above 0.7. A POLICY (tunable by editing this threshold), NOT a universal metric.
attrs.rationale: reopen_threshold >= sufficiency_threshold gives a dead-band between 'good enough to leave' (<=0.5) and 'salient enough to reopen' (>0.7): issues do not thrash across the stop boundary. Raise it to reopen less eagerly (wider hysteresis); lower it toward the sufficiency threshold to reopen as soon as a deferred gap would no longer be deferred.
